--
This pull request wires the gh-run and gh-pr families into the compactor.

It moves the expectedFormat map into its own file, accepts a set of formats
per family, and flips the two inventory rows to "compresses".

The body is long on purpose: it describes the motivation, the design, the
tests, and the measured before/after so a reviewer has the full picture
without opening every file. An agent reading this through the wrapper only
needs the title, state, number and author to decide what to do next, so the
body and the rest of the header are dropped.
